text:
Dear Sir or Madam

I need advice quickly. I'm a caretaker for the buildings of Ahornweid Management Ltd in Lausanne and I've had a really bad few weeks. On 12 February 2026 I came down with pneumonia. My doctor wrote me off sick for ten days, from 12 to 21 February, and I have the certificate. I didn't choose to get ill, I caught it like half of Lausanne did this winter.

Before that, on 7 February 2026, Clara Hofer, the manager, gave me a letter saying they were ending my employment. She said it was 'not working out' and that was all. The letter said my last day would be 14 February.

I've attached my employment contract so you can see who I work for and when I started there.

To be clear about the timing: the letter came first. Everything else started after 7 February, while I was still working out my notice and before 14 February had come.

I know they will say I was still on trial, and that's true, I had only started on 19 January, so I was still in my trial period when she gave me the letter.

On top of the illness, I had to do my civil defence service. I was called up for 9 to 11 February, so I was away on service for those three days, again after I had the letter and before my last day. My colleague Owen Lüthi covered my buildings while I was away, so nobody can say the work was left undone.

My wage was CHF 2,090 a month and I have rent to pay at Gartenstrasse 68. Can you tell me whether my service and my illness change anything about that notice, and what I can do?

Thank you,
Jack Meier

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (extract)

Between
Ahornweid Management Ltd, Lausanne, represented by Ms Clara Hofer, Property Manager (the employer)
and
Mr Jack Meier, Gartenstrasse 68, Lausanne (the employee)

1. Position
The employee is engaged as a building caretaker for the residential properties managed by the employer in Lausanne.

2. Start of employment
The employment begins on 19 January 2026.

3. Working time and pay
The employee works part-time according to the weekly rota. The gross monthly wage is CHF 2,090, paid at the end of each month.

4. Duties
Cleaning of common areas, small repairs, waste collection, contact with tenants.

Lausanne, 12 January 2026

For the employer: Clara Hofer
Employee: Jack Meier
